question: Who among the following signed the Poona pact with Mahatma Gandhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhimrao Ambedkar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhimrao Ambedkar:-**

 
 
• He​** **signed the** Poona pact** with **Mahatma Gandhi **in **1932.**
 
• The Poona pact was an agreement between the** leaders of the Dalit community** and the** Indian National Congres**s.
 
• It aimed to secure **reserved seats for Dalits **in the provincial legislative councils.
 
 
 
• **Poona Pact:-**
 
 
• **It refers to an agreement reached in September 1932 between leaders of the Dalit community (formerly referred to as "Untouchables") and leaders of the upper-caste Hindu community within the context of British India. **
 
• The pact was a significant development during the movement for Dalit rights and representation in the political sphere.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chittaranjan Das:-**

 
 
• He​ was a **Bengali lawyer and politician **who played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was a prominent member of the Indian National Congress and founded the** Swaraj Party.**
 
 
 
• **Jyotiba Phule:-**
 
 
• He was a** social reformer and activist **who worked for the upliftment of the Dalit and women communities in Maharashtra.
 
• He founded the **Satyashodhak Samaj **and is considered to be one of the pioneers of the social reform movement in India.
 
 
 
• **Ali Brothers:-**
 
 
• It comprises of Muhammad Ali Jinnah and Shaukat Ali, were prominent Muslim leaders who played a key role in the **Indian independence movement.**
 
• They founded the **All India Muslim League in 1906** and advocated for the creation of a** separate Muslim state**, which eventually led to the formation of Pakistan.
